name: io.github.qungtai/discord-mcp
description: A community MCP server for the Discord REST API with traceable coverage

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_GUILDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed guild IDs. When set, operations outside these guilds are refused.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of enabled toolsets. Available: core, messages, reactions, threads, channels, webhooks, guild, members, roles, moderation, events, invites.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Blocks all mutating actions and allows read-only tools only (true or false). Any other value stops startup.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_APPROVAL
environmentVariables.description: Confirmation mode for destructive operations (elicitation or none). Any other value stops startup.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOW_DMS
environmentVariables.description: Permits direct messages and user-scoped operations alongside an active guild allowlist (true or false). Any other value stops startup.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of absolute directory paths accessible for uploads. When unset, empty, or parsing to no entries, file access is open by default for any absolute path, except hidden files and directories.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute directory path where attachment downloads are stored. Defaults to ~/Downloads/discord-mcp and is created recursively on first download.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum download size in bytes for discord_download_attachment (defaults to 100 MiB).

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum upload size in bytes (defaults to 20 MiB).

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Discord REST API requests.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum wait duration in milliseconds when encountering a Discord rate limit before aborting.
